entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought. I received it 12 days ago and I'd like to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
It's not broken, but I'm finding it very **confusing** to navigate. It seems really **hard to use**, especially the workout planning features. To be honest, I **expected more** from it.
I understand. I know new tech can have a learning curve. Which specific feature are you having trouble with? Sometimes the **user manual** doesn't capture the small details.
It's the 'Dynamic Pacing' feature. I'm trying to set up different pace targets for a 10k run, but I can't seem to input the segments correctly on the band itself. It's not intuitive at all.

Ah, that's a fantastic feature, but also one of our most common questions. That's actually a setting you configure in the VeloFit app on your phone, not on the band directly. The band just executes the plan after you sync it. Would you like to walk through it with me right now?
Really? I thought it was all done on the device. Okay, sure. I have the app open now.

Great. Tap on 'Training Plans,' then 'Create New.' From there, select 'Pacing Workout.' You should see an interface that lets you add segments and assign a target pace to each one. This gives you much more control than trying to do it on the small screen.
Wow. Okay, I see it. This is exactly what I was looking for. That's so much easier. The manual made it seem like I had to do it all from the watch. This changes things.

I'm glad that helped! It's designed that way so you can do the detailed planning on your phone and then just have a simple start-and-go experience on your run. Is there anything else I can clarify for you?

No, that solves my main problem. I think I'll keep the band now. I do appreciate your help, David. However, I did spend a couple of days being quite frustrated, and since the manual was misleading, I feel like I'm not getting the full value. As a long-time VeloFit VIP member, is there perhaps a discount code or a small credit you could offer for the trouble?

That's a completely fair point, and I apologize for the frustration our user manual caused. Your feedback is valuable, and I'll be sure to pass it along. And of course, we want to take care of our VIP members. For your patience, I've just applied a $25 store credit to your account. You can use it on any future VeloFit apparel or accessory purchase.
A $25 credit works for me. That's very reasonable. Thank you for your help today, David. You've been great.
You're most welcome. I'm happy we could get the VeloBand working the way you need it to. Enjoy your next run, and thanks for calling VeloFit!
